paragraphs: Johnson & Johnson (J&J) is an American multinational pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical technologies corporation headquartered in New Brunswick, New Jersey. The company is ranked No. 42 on the 2026 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations. In 2026, the company was ranked 43rd in the Forbes Global 2000. Along with Microsoft, Johnson & Johnson is one of only two U.S.-based companies that has a prime credit rating of AAA from S&P Global.

people.name: Vanessa Broadhurst
people.title: Member, Executive Committee; Executive Vice President, Global Corporate Affairs
people.bio: Broadhurst rejoined the Company in 2017 after holding General Manager roles at Amgen from 2013 to 2017. She previously held Company leadership roles from 2005 to 2013 and became Company Group Chairman, Global Commercial Strategy Organization in 2018.
people.quote: Ms. V. Broadhurst was named Executive Vice President, Global Corporate Affairs and appointed to the Executive Committee in 2022.

people.name: Joaquin Duato
people.title: Chairman of the Board; Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Duato became Chief Executive Officer and Director in 2022 and Chairman of the Board in 2023. He first joined the Company in 1989 with Janssen-Farmaceutica S.A. (Spain) and previously served as Executive Vice President, Worldwide Chairman, Pharmaceuticals and Vice Chairman of the Executive Committee.
people.quote: Mr. J. Duato became Chairman of the Board of Directors in 2023 subsequent to his appointments as Chief Executive Officer and Director in 2022.

people.name: Elizabeth Forminard
people.title: Member, Executive Committee; Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer
people.bio: Forminard joined the Company in 2006 and held increasingly responsible legal and corporate governance roles. Her immediately preceding role was General Counsel Pharmaceuticals.
people.quote: Ms. E. Forminard was appointed Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and a member of the Executive Committee in 2022.

people.name: Kristen Mulholland
people.title: Member, Executive Committee; Executive Vice President, Chief Human Resources Officer
people.bio: Mulholland joined the Company in 2005 and has held HR leadership positions across MedTech, Innovative Medicines, Corporate Functions and Corporate HR Services. Her prior responsibilities included Performance and Development and, most recently, Global Total Rewards.
people.quote: Ms. K. Mulholland was appointed Executive Vice President, Chief Human Resources Officer and appointed to the Executive Committee in 2024.

people.name: John C. Reed
people.title: Member, Executive Committee; Executive Vice President, Innovative Medicine, R&D
people.bio: Reed joined the Company in 2023 after holding executive leadership positions at Sanofi from 2018 to 2022 and Roche from 2013 to 2018, serving on both executive committees. He also served as CEO of Sanford-Burnham Medical Research Institute.
people.quote: Dr. J. C. Reed joined the Company in 2023 as Executive Vice President, Innovative Medicine, R&D and a member of the Executive Committee.

people.name: Tim Schmid
people.title: Member, Executive Committee; Executive Vice President, Worldwide Chairman, MedTech
people.bio: Schmid joined the Company in 1993 and held MedTech leadership positions including Chief Strategic Customer Officer and President of Ethicon. He served as Company Group Chairman MedTech Asia Pacific from 2018 to 2023.
people.quote: Mr. T. Schmid was appointed Executive Vice President, Worldwide Chairman, MedTech and a member of the Executive Committee in 2023.

people.name: James Swanson
people.title: Member, Executive Committee; Executive Vice President, Chief Information Officer
people.bio: Swanson rejoined the Company in 2019 as Chief Information Officer after serving at Bayer Crop Science as Chief Information Officer and Head of Digital Transformation. He previously held Company positions of increasing responsibility from 1996 to 2005.
people.quote: Mr. J. Swanson was appointed Executive Vice President, Chief Information Officer and a member of the Executive Committee in 2022.

people.name: Jennifer L. Taubert
people.title: Member, Executive Committee; Executive Vice President, Worldwide Chairman, Innovative Medicine
people.bio: Taubert joined the Company in 2005 as Worldwide Vice President and held increasingly responsible executive positions in the Pharmaceuticals sector. These included Company Group Chairman, North America and Company Group Chairman, The Americas.
people.quote: Ms. J. L. Taubert was appointed Executive Vice President, Worldwide Chairman, Innovative Medicine and a member of the Executive Committee in 2018.

people.name: Kathryn E. Wengel
people.title: Member, Executive Committee; Executive Vice President, Chief Technical Operations & Risk Officer
people.bio: Wengel first joined the Company in 1988 as Project Engineer and Engineering Supervisor at Janssen. She became Executive Vice President, Chief Global Supply Chain Officer and an Executive Committee member in 2018 before assuming her current role in 2023.
people.quote: Ms. Wengel first joined the Company in 1988 as Project Engineer and Engineering Supervisor at Janssen, a subsidiary of the Company.

people.name: Joseph J. Wolk
people.title: Member, Executive Committee; Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Wolk first joined the Company in 1998 as Finance Manager, Business Development for Ortho-McNeil. His prior roles included Vice President, Finance and Chief Financial Officer of the Janssen Pharmaceutical Companies and Vice President, Investor Relations.
people.quote: Mr. J. J. Wolk was appointed Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and a member of the Executive Committee in 2018.
